author: PolarClad
body: Hello! My name is PolarClad. I have come to make an appeal for my ban. So I was banned on July 22 2015 12:14:57 AM GMT. I am really sorry for hacking but sometimes the battles get hard and I really feel bad about dying a lot but I decided after a while that hacking isn't the answer it will just lead to a ban like I had. I am sorry for that I really want to come back as this is a very nice server and I dont want to get banned again if I'm unbanned I've been waiting for a long time and now I decided to try to come back. Thank you :).
